zh.title: 美國邁阿密國際機場查獲2男涉嫌走私21隻鳥
zh.summary: 2名男子涉嫌在內褲中藏匿21隻鳥，於邁阿密國際機場被捕；Simple Flying指其疑似規避進口規定
body: Simple Flying報導，2名男子在美國邁阿密國際機場（MIA）被捕，涉嫌走私21隻鳥。
該報導的摘要指出，人員發現鳥隻被縫入內褲與拼湊而成的腰帶中。
Simple Flying在摘要中稱，這起案件顯示有人以精心安排的方式規避進口規定。
報導未說明2名男子的身分、涉案鳥隻的種類、查獲的確切日期，也未交代案件目前的處理情形。

en.title: 2 men arrested over smuggling 21 birds in underwear at Miami International Airport
en.summary: Two men arrested at Miami International Airport; agents reportedly found 21 birds sewn into underwear and belts
body: Two men were arrested at Miami International Airport (MIA) in the United States over the smuggling of 21 birds, according to Simple Flying.
The report's summary said agents found birds sewn into underwear and cobbled belts.
Simple Flying described the matter as revealing elaborate schemes to bypass import rules.
The report did not identify the two men, the species of birds involved, the exact date of the discovery or the current status of the case.
